# Brief

Hand-written, no brief: the v0.5 register fixture, the six clinic domains
(`vet-core`, `vet-housing`, `vet-scheduling`, `vet-lab`, `vet-machinery`,
`vet-portal`) composed as the clinic load fixture places them, with
`governance:`, a data policy and the data register the data-register skill
generates (chunk 17b, spec D434). Loaded by `tools/tests/test_model.py`,
never deployed. Not a game.
